title: Naval combat / trading combat showcase
author: PhotoDisastrous8275
selftext:
I posted the game ive been working on and some of you asked to see combat footage.  
Here is some. It's far from polished but it's what I got so far. Let me know if you like it or if it looks / feels sluggish

comments.author: Matiesyx
comments.body:
Hey! Looks nice. To make battles more skill-based, you could add a wind mechanic and/or more varied terrain, so players have to adapt their shots to win.  
Also, the sound feels a bit generic right now. I used Suno for both the music and the sound effects in my own game, and it really helped give it more character. Might be worth a try!  
I'm also building a game with AI, so if you're curious, feel free to check it out :)

comments.author: completelypositive
comments.body: Can somebody reverse engineer AC:Black Flag and Sid Meyers Pirates, an then combine those into a game? What you have is pretty cool too, but I'm craving some dance scenes in between my massacring.
